name: NorthRay Browser
tagline: A web browser for Windows in the NorthRay look, with creative tools planned.
description: NorthRay Browser is a desktop web browser for Windows. Web pages are shown by Microsoft Edge WebView2, the Chromium engine that comes with Windows 11 and is kept up to date by Windows, with its sandbox left fully on. It has tabs; an address bar that opens addresses, local files and searches (and never sends a file path or a local network address to a search engine); a start page with your bookmarks; bookmarks with folders, a bookmarks bar and a bookmarks page, imported from or exported to Chrome, Edge and Firefox; and saved passwords and form filling, kept encrypted on your PC by the engine's password manager. Certificate errors are always refused. History, a downloads panel, profiles, private windows and the creative tools (collections, notes, boards and more) come in later versions.
features: Tabs: open, close, reopen closed tabs, switch with the keyboard; links that open new windows open as tabs
Address bar: web addresses, local files and searches with DuckDuckGo, Google, Bing or another engine; file paths and local network addresses are never searched for
Bookmarks: a star in the address bar, a bookmarks bar, folders, a bookmarks page with search, and import and export in the format Chrome, Edge and Firefox use; a daily backup
A start page with a greeting, a search field, your bookmarks as tiles and recently closed tabs; nothing on it loads from the internet
Saved passwords and form filling, offered after you sign in, encrypted with a key protected by your Windows account; turn them off or delete them all from the menu
A padlock for secure sites and a plain "Not secure" for others; certificate problems are refused with an explanation
Full screen, printing, developer tools, and light and dark themes that follow Windows
Edge's sandbox and SmartScreen protection against phishing and harmful downloads; no telemetry of NorthRay's own

credits.comment: Empty developer and publisher mean the central identity in brand/identity.json.
